summary: Questions from the first hearing give the applicant a reason to come back before the same commissioners.
realLife: The Arlington Heights Plan Commission scheduled two additional hearings in part to give the developer a chance to answer questions raised at the first.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with applicant, question, next meeting. A commissioner who asked a question can recognize the answer at a later meeting.

turns.what: The builder brings the traffic estimate but still owes an answer about school enrollment.
turns.pulledBy: The traffic engineer has replied and the school district has not.
turns.writesBack: The chair carries just the enrollment question forward.

turns.what: At the next meeting the resident who asked about traffic says the answer covers the wrong street.
turns.pulledBy: The estimate counts the main entrance and the resident named the service entrance.
turns.writesBack: The minutes carry the service entrance forward as an open question.
